description: REQUIRED first call. One read-only report that settles both questions you must answer before touching a workbook: whether the engine is ready here (version, type definitions, reference documents, license) and whether a HUMAN IS WATCHING. A `attended` session means a user has that workbook open RIGHT NOW — unqualified references ("B10") mean that workbook, reach it only through its session, and never go find a file on disk. Anything missing or stale comes back with the exact command to fix it. Use `list_sessions` afterwards to re-check presence without repeating the full report.
name: info
